# Image to STL Converter

> Free online image to STL converter for 3D printing. Convert JPG, PNG, and SVG images to STL, OBJ, and GLB 3D models. All processing happens in your browser — no uploads, no registration, free forever.

Image to STL Converter is a browser-based toolchain that turns 2D images into 3D-printable models. It supports heightmap conversion (brightness to 3D height), SVG vector extrusion, lithophane generation, text-to-3D, and cookie cutter generation. Output is watertight binary STL compatible with Cura, PrusaSlicer, and Bambu Studio, plus OBJ and GLB exports.

## Tools

- [Image to STL Converter](https://www.image-2-stl.com/): Main converter with heightmap, SVG extrusion, and lithophane modes plus real-time 3D preview.
- [JPG to STL](https://www.image-2-stl.com/jpg-to-stl/): Convert JPG photos to 3D-printable STL models.
- [PNG to STL](https://www.image-2-stl.com/png-to-stl/): Convert PNG images with transparency to 3D models.
- [SVG to STL](https://www.image-2-stl.com/svg-to-stl/): Extrude SVG vector paths into solid 3D geometry with crisp edges.
- [Text to STL](https://www.image-2-stl.com/text-to-stl/): Turn text into 3D-printable embossed or extruded models.
- [Cookie Cutter](https://www.image-2-stl.com/cookie-cutter/): Generate cookie cutter and fondant cutter molds from images.
- [Lithophane Maker](https://www.image-2-stl.com/lithophane-maker/): Turn photos into backlit lithophane panels for 3D printing.
- [Photo to 3D](https://www.image-2-stl.com/photo-to-3d/): Convert photos into 3D relief models.
- [Heightmap Editor](https://www.image-2-stl.com/heightmap-editor/): Adjust brightness, contrast, and levels before converting to 3D.
